The '''Imperial garrison post''' on the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mantooine/Legends|Mantooine]] was the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] initial token [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] presence in the [[Mantooine system/Legends|Mantooine system]]. The post was established after the [[Mantooine Liberators]] proved to be the most active resistance group in the Atrivis [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. Striking from the mountainous wilderness of their sparsely populated world, the Liberators promptly [[Battle on Mantooine/Legends|attacked]] the weak Imperial [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] and took its [[Weapon/Legends|weaponry]] and equipment. However, the Liberators were inexperienced, occupying the post instead of retreating into the wilderness and boldly broadcasting a call to action for all of Mantooine to revolt against the Imperial government.<ref name="RASB" />

Thus, an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial strike fleet]] waiting in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of [[Fest/Legends|Fest]] in the neighboring [[Fest system/Legends|Fest system]] decimated the Liberators. The massacre demonstrated the need for organized resistance; [[Travia Chan/Legends|Travia Chan's]] [[Fest Resistance Group]] united with [[Loom Carplin]]'s surviving Mantooine Liberators, forming the [[Atrivis Resistance Group]] which then joined the [[The galaxy/Legends|pan-galactic]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] as its [[Atrivis Sector Force]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the Atrivis Forces had helped [[Operation Cobolt|destroy]] the [[Imperial orbital base]] that replaced Mantooine's garrison and fielded an army of several thousand Rebels that dominated the planet's rural countryside.<ref name="RASB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial garrison post was introduced in [[Paul Murphy]]'s ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]'', published by [[West End Games]] in [[1990]] for the [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|first edition]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="RAS">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref>
